existing_rules: Keys are the official source host, not the record title, so an official rename does not silently orphan an entry.
Add an entry only when the logo is known to be the institution's own and the URL is stable.
official_host must be true only when the bytes are served by the institution itself. A third-party host (for example Wikimedia) must be false, because the record's provenance says so.
An entry is a candidate, not an approval: every override still goes through the ordinary image validator.
Every URL below was probed live and returned HTTP 200 with an image content type before being added.

White-on-transparent wordmarks are deliberately excluded. A white logo is invisible on a light card, so shipping one would replace a missing image with a broken one; use a dark variant or leave the record without a logo.
A host whose logo URL returns HTML rather than image bytes is excluded. That is a WAF interstitial or an error page, not a logo, and it would be stored as a broken image.
